Sign in with your TV Provider to catch live sports like NBA on TNT, NHL on TNT, U.S. Soccer, and TNT Originals like AEW: Collision and The Lazarus Project! Watch anytime, anywhere with the TNT app. Plus, enjoy classic shows and blockbuster movies -- on any screen. The TNT app supports most TV providers, including AT&T, Spectrum (incl. Been trying for a week now. Very frustrating. Once I get through these 3 episodes I'll probably delete the app because it sucks so bad!105 people found this review helpfulTurner Entertainment Networks23 July 2020Thanks for sharing your feedback so that we can work towards fixing this problem. The TNT logo appears, so you know there's a connection, but no show will ever actually stream. This is a bigger problem than most networks since the television app requires you to use your smart phone as a remote. It does work fine if you're watching on your phone, but it's 2019.
